method: static inspection of shipped artifacts; counts are regex over file text
conclusion: The static shell stylesheet consumes --dsw-* tokens (436 uses) but declares almost none (2), while ui-theme's client bundle declares 403. Client-plugin sheets are appended to document.head at materialization (dsh-client-ui-theme/lib/client.js:1183-1192), i.e. after any webserver/index-inject head row, so a first-paint :root{--dsw-*} override loses the cascade and must be scoped to a body attribute.
